name: RVL-CDIP: Complex Document Information Processing Benchmark
description: A canonical benchmark dataset for document image classification and visual document layout analysis. Curated by the Ryerson Vision Lab and Carnegie Mellon University. Consists of 400,000 grayscale document images sampled from the public Truth Tobacco Industry Documents archive. Divided into 16 distinct document categories (letter, form, email, handwritten, memo, invoice, budget, resume, advertisement, etc.) with exactly 25,000 images per category.
